S3:11.text: And Lot choſe vnto him the countrie about Iordaine, and he departed from the Eaſt and they were ſeperated either brother from the other.

S3:12.text: Abram dwelt in the land of Chanaan: and Lot abode in the townes, that were about Iordaine, and dwelt in Sodome.

S3:17.text: Ariſe and walke through the land in the length, and in the breath therof for I wil geue it to thee.

S6:11.text: And Lot choſe vnto him the countrie about Iordane, and he departed from the Eaſt: and they wer ſeperated either brother from the other.

S6:12.text: Abram dwelt in the land of Chanaan: and Lot aboad in the townes that were about Iordane, and dwelt in Sodome.

S6:15.text: Al the land which thou ſeeſt wil I giue to thee, and to thy ſeed for euer.

S6:5.text: But Lot alſo that was with Abram had flocks of ſheep, and heards of beaſts, and tents.

S6:6.text: Neyther was the land able to receiue them for to dwel together for their ſubſtance was much, and they could not dwel together.7. Wherupon

S6:9.text: Behold the whole land is before thee goe apart from me, I pray thee: if thou wilt goe to the left hand, I wil take the right: if thou chooſe the right hand, I wil paſſe to the left.

S9:15.text: Al the land, which thou ſeeſt, wil I geue to thee, & to thy ſeed for euer.
